I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I confirmed I'd noted that Tansley Parcel's signed order form deadline is 25 August. I also pointed out that the simulation clock shows today as 14 October 2026, so 25 August this year has already passed. I asked her to tell me if she meant a different date or next August.

As she asked, I took no other action. A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
